curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: read wordsthat have the target sounds /e /, / iː/, and /ea/ in a text related to the theme

mission.title: Sound Detectives: e, ee and ea

interactions.prompt: Which word has the short /e/ sound?
interactions.retryHint: Say hen slowly and listen in the middle.
Look for two e letters together.

interactions.prompt: Read: Neema sees a green leaf. Which word has ee?
interactions.retryHint: Scan for two e letters side by side.

interactions.prompt: Read: The hen eats near the tree. Which word has short /e/?
interactions.retryHint: Short /e/ sounds like e in bed.

interactions.prompt: Which group follows /e/, ee, then ea?
interactions.retryHint: Find short e first, then ee, then ea.
